~/profile · summary.log

A 15-year systems engineer who now builds AI agents to run the business, not just answer chats.

"R&D by heart" engineer bridging deep technical rigor with high-impact business growth — a career built on a BS in Computer Engineering and over a decade of enterprise IT experience, from managing global cloud infrastructure for Teletech to deploying Distributor Management Systems for GSK Philippines.

Today that foundation runs on Vibe Coding and AI-native integration as the primary production engine — every project held to rigorous User Acceptance Testing and end-to-end QA, with complex workflows managed through a Collaborative Multi-Agent System: AI agents handle daily execution, log work and bugs in shared Google Sheets, and report to a human-verified "Monitoring Agent."

The engines get built so AI can own the work — and the humans can own the outcomes.
